data.name: Signs of Danger
data.detailed_description:
Playtest Signup at slowrush.dev


About the Game

Team Up, then Blow Their Worlds Up

Fight through fully reactive pixel-physics alien worlds where everything burns, melts, shocks, and explodes.
Built for solo play or up to four-player online and couch co-op, so every disaster can be shared.

Per-pixel physics chaos meets multiplayer mayhem, turning every chain reaction into a shared disaster. Cascading explosions, melting terrain, volatile liquids, and unstable elements are now things you can unleash with friends - or onto them.

You are Convict Marines sent to unstable alien planets full of forbidden technology and dangerous relics - relics that the Imperial Empire insists do not exist. Redeem your honor by surviving your sentence and extracting with the relics - and try not to vaporize your squad.

Every world reacts at the pixel level. Fire spreads, liquids flow, electricity jumps, unstable chemicals explode, and exotic matter behaves unpredictably. One poorly-aimed shot can trigger a chain reaction that engulfs half the level.

Play solo or with up to three friends in seamless 4-player drop-in-drop-out online and couch co-op. Expect chaos: friendly fire, fast respawns, and even faster "accidents".

Decipher the Signs of Danger

Scavenge for alien Signs. Use that forbidden tech to craft, mutate, and overload your weapons and abilities. Experiment until you create game-breaking combos that should never be allowed in the hands of any marine.

Build a shotgun that fires homing teleporting missiles. Dash through walls to liquefy enemies. Detonate a small personal nuke when you die. Release swarms of suicidal drones every time you take a hit. The right Signs will turn you into a one-person disaster zone.



But be warned: Signs behave differently depending on how they are combined with your weaponry. Careless experimentation can erase you, your squad, or the entire level. The line between godhood and catastrophe is very thin.

Features

  • Fully reactive "falling sand" pixel-simulated levels set on alien planets.
  • Chaotic online and couch co-op for up to 4 players.
  • Wild weapon crafting by combining and stacking alien Signs.
  • Defeat hordes of hostile alien creatures and powerful bosses.
  • Physics-based destruction with fire, liquids, electricity, and chemical reactions.
  • Game-breaking ability combos that change every run.
  • Friendly fire, fast respawns, and constant "accidents".
  • Randomized handmade levels filled with unpredictable chain reactions.
  • Solo-friendly mode for experimentation and chaos.

data.short_description: Drop onto dangerously reactive alien planets where every pixel is physically simulated. Craft wild guns and abilities that melt, burn, freeze and blow up hostile creatures or destroy entire levels - solo or with up to three friends in chaotic 4-player online and couch co-op.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: More is better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM, Nvidia 1080 or better
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: MacOS 26 (Tahoe)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Apple support is tentative
mac_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: MacOS 26 (Tahoe)
  • Processor: Apple M2 or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 or better
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
